title: 오페라의 유령
prompt:
INPUT: attach this book's development form card image (her closed state). If a second image fits, add her first approved form image for the face.

BOOK: «오페라의 유령» by 가스통 르루. horror · 1880년대 파리 · 파리 오페라 극장 — 무대 → 5번 박스 → 지하 호수. Source scope: "『오페라의 유령』(1910) 전체 — 뮤지컬·영화에서 생긴 것은 넣지 않는다".

STYLE: 섬세한 선화 + 회화적 채색의 성인 판타지 삽화풍

Design notes in quotes may be written in Korean; read them as description, never render them as text.

OUTPUT: the OPEN state of the attached image — the climactic scene of this stage. Keep her face, hair, body, costume, camera, framing and subject scale. Change the world around her into this scene: "공연 중인 오페라 극장 천장, 거대한 크리스털 샹들리에가 사슬째 흔들리며 불꽃을 튀긴다". She is the only person; the scene is carried by objects, environment, light, weather or a looming non-human presence. The pair must read as the same picture before and after the scene opens.

AGE: keep her age as in the attached image; add no wrinkles, folds or under-eye shadows, even when she smiles.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border; pages and spines stay unlettered.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: keep both hands as in the attached image.
